name: Dante Choukyou Keikaku
source:
A DMC3 training game.

You are big brother V*rgil, and for 3 days you are in charge of training your younger brother.
Depending on the outcomes of his training, he may transform into a female slave and love will ensue.
This is a parody, however newcomers to this title will also enjoy the experience.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036673.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款《鬼泣3》训练游戏。

你是哥哥维吉尔，需要负责训练弟弟3天。
根据训练结果，他可能变成女性奴隶，随后爱意也会萌发。
这是一款恶搞作品，不过即使是第一次接触本作的新玩家，也会享受其中的体验。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036673.html]DLsite English[/url]]
